dialogue.content: （こんにちは。本日は相談者役宜しくお願い致します。時間になりましたら始めさせていただきます。）
dialogue.English: (Hello. Thank you for playing the role of the client today. We'll begin when it's time.)

dialogue.content: （こんにちは。よろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Hello. I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。本日はお越しいただきありがとうございます。はじめに年齢、性別、相談内容を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming in today. To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?
15, male.

dialogue.content: やっちゃいけないことをするのをやめたい
dialogue.English: I want to stop doing things I shouldn't.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。やってはいけないこと、というのはどんなことか詳しく聞いてもよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. May I ask in more detail what you mean by 'things you shouldn't do'?

dialogue.content: 秘密になりますか？
dialogue.English: Will this be kept confidential?

dialogue.content: ええここでの会話はどこにも伝わらないので安心してお話しください。
dialogue.English: Yes, our conversation here won't be shared with anyone, so please feel free to speak openly.

dialogue.content: バレない？
dialogue.English: No one will find out?

dialogue.content: ここでの秘密はお守りしますよ。お話やすいところからで大丈夫ですよ
dialogue.English: I will protect your confidentiality here. You can start wherever feels most comfortable for you.

dialogue.content: わかった
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 万引きをやめたい
dialogue.English: I want to stop shoplifting.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。勇気を出してお話しくださりありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you for having the courage to share that.

dialogue.content: 辞めたいお気持ちがあるのですね。ちなみにそれは何回かされたのですか？
dialogue.English: So you have the desire to stop. By the way, have you done it multiple times?

dialogue.content: 中1から何回も
dialogue.English: Many times since my first year of junior high.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。始めるのに何かきっかけはあったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Was there something that led you to start?

dialogue.content: 中1の時にクラスのヤツにスーパーに家族で買い物してるところを見られて
dialogue.English: In my first year of junior high, a guy from my class saw me shopping at the supermarket with my family,

dialogue.content: バカにされて
dialogue.English: and he made fun of me,

dialogue.content: 万引きくらいできるって
dialogue.English: saying something like, 'You should at least be able to shoplift.'

dialogue.content: そのようなことがあったのですね。クラスの人に言われたのが悔しく思ったのですね。
dialogue.English: So that's what happened. You must have felt frustrated being told that by a classmate.

dialogue.content: 悔しかった
dialogue.English: I was frustrated.

dialogue.content: でもそいつもちょっと怖いヤツで
dialogue.English: But he was also kind of a scary guy,

dialogue.content: 断れなくなって
dialogue.English: and I couldn't say no.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。その時、その人にはなんて言われたのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. What exactly did he say to you at that time?

dialogue.content: 言われたっていうか
dialogue.English: It's not so much that he said something,

dialogue.content: 補導されたりしたこともあるヤツ
dialogue.English: he's the kind of guy who's even been picked up by the police before.

dialogue.content: 周りから怖がられている人なのですね。その人から万引きしてみろよ、みたいに言われた感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So he's someone that others are afraid of. Did he say something like, 'Go on, try shoplifting'?

dialogue.content: あそうです
dialogue.English: Ah, yes, that's it.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね悔しさや怖い気持ちもあってついやってしまったのですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. So you ended up doing it out of a mix of frustration and fear.

dialogue.content: 中2の終わりにそいつが転校するまで何回もやって
dialogue.English: I did it many times until he transferred at the end of my second year of junior high,

dialogue.content: その後しばらくやめてた
dialogue.English: and after that, I stopped for a while.

dialogue.content: でも受験のストレスで去年の冬くらいからまた
dialogue.English: but because of the stress from entrance exams, I started again around last winter,

dialogue.content: 今度は1人でもやるようになって
dialogue.English: and this time I started doing it even by myself.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね。その人は居なくなったのですね。しばらく辞めてたけどストレスもあって一人でまたしてしまったのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that person was gone. You had stopped for a while, but then you started again on your own due to stress.

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ちなみに万引きしたときはどんなお気持ちになりますか？ストレス解消になる感じですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, how do you feel when you shoplift? Does it feel like a way to relieve stress?

dialogue.content: 高校合格してからはまたやめてでも
dialogue.English: After getting into high school I stopped again, but

dialogue.content: この前1回やっちゃって
dialogue.English: I did it once the other day,

dialogue.content: 後悔してる
dialogue.English: and I regret it.

dialogue.content: 受験の時はやるとスッとしたから
dialogue.English: During the entrance exams, doing it made me feel relieved,

dialogue.content: この前はいい気持ちじゃなかった
dialogue.English: but this last time it didn't feel good.

dialogue.content: そのようなお気持ちなのですね。では自分でやってはいけないことだとちゃんと分かっていて、きっぱり辞めたいと思うようになったのですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you feel. It sounds like you're fully aware that it's wrong, and you've come to want to stop completely.

dialogue.content: やっちゃいけないっていうのは最初からわかってる
dialogue.English: I've known from the beginning that I shouldn't do it.

dialogue.content: 最初は怖かったし嫌だったけど
dialogue.English: At first it was scary and I didn't like it, but

dialogue.content: 3回目くらいからドキドキして楽しかった
dialogue.English: from about the third time, the thrill was exciting.

dialogue.content: でもダメだと思ったし、1人じゃ怖くてできなかったから1度やめた
dialogue.English: But I knew it was wrong, and I was too scared to do it alone, so I stopped for a while.

dialogue.content: 気持が高ぶることもあったのですね。その時のこと思い出してストレスが溜まるとやってしまった感じなのですね
dialogue.English: So there were times when you felt a rush. It seems like when you get stressed, you remember that feeling and end up doing it.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれない
dialogue.English: That might be it.

dialogue.content: 捕まるかもしれないし、もうやめたい
dialogue.English: I could get caught, and I really want to stop now.

dialogue.content: でもまたやっちゃいそう
dialogue.English: But I feel like I might do it again.

dialogue.content: 色々な葛藤があってとても苦しかったですね。
dialogue.English: You've been struggling with a lot of conflicting feelings. That must have been very painful.

dialogue.content: またやりたい、と思う時はどんな時がありますか？
dialogue.English: When are the times you feel like you want to do it again?

dialogue.content: 高校でクラスに馴染めなくて
dialogue.English: When I can't fit in with my class at high school...

dialogue.content: テストも悪かったから
dialogue.English: and my test scores were bad.

dialogue.content: 学校で嫌な気分になったときにまた頭によぎる感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So it crosses your mind when you have negative feelings at school?

dialogue.content: そうかもしれない
dialogue.English: That might be it.

dialogue.content: うまくいかない
dialogue.English: Things aren't going well.

dialogue.content: つまんない
dialogue.English: It's boring.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。上手くいかない中、自分と闘ってきたのですね。
dialogue.English: I see. While things weren't going well, you've been fighting a battle with yourself.

dialogue.content: たたかってたのかな
dialogue.English: I wonder if I was fighting.

dialogue.content: 勇気を出してこうして相談にきてくれたこともそうですし、あなたがどうにかしたいという思いが伝わりますよ。
dialogue.English: The fact that you gathered the courage to come here and talk is part of that battle. I can tell you truly want to do something about this.

dialogue.content: もし学校生活が楽しくなったら万引きのことを少し忘れられそうですか？
dialogue.English: If school life became more enjoyable, do you think you might be able to think about shoplifting less?

dialogue.content: わからない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: そうかもしれない
dialogue.English: Maybe so.

dialogue.content: でもまた受験がある
dialogue.English: But there's another entrance exam coming up.

dialogue.content: 一番嫌だと思うことは勉強ですか？それとも他にありますか？
dialogue.English: Is studying the thing you dislike the most, or is there something else?

dialogue.content: 受験勉強は好きじゃないけど学校の勉強は別に
dialogue.English: I don't like studying for entrance exams, but regular schoolwork isn't especially bad.

dialogue.content: 嫌っていうか楽しくない毎日
dialogue.English: It's not that I hate it; it's that every day isn't fun.

dialogue.content: 万引きは1人でできるし
dialogue.English: I can shoplift alone,

dialogue.content: スリルあるし
dialogue.English: and it's thrilling.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。毎日つまらないと感じているとストレスを感じるのは無理ないことですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's perfectly understandable that you'd feel stressed if you feel that every day is boring.

dialogue.content: そうつまんない
dialogue.English: Yeah, it's boring.

dialogue.content: なのでいま万引きみたいなスリルあることをしたくなってしまうと思うのですが、これを他のことに置き換えることが出来ればあなたがまた後悔しないで済むかと思いますがいかかですか？
dialogue.English: So, I think that's why you feel the urge to do something thrilling like shoplifting. But if we could replace that with something else, I think it would help you avoid regretting it again. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: ほかのこと？
dialogue.English: Something else?

dialogue.content: なにか好きなことや興味のあることはありますか？
dialogue.English: Do you have any hobbies or interests?

dialogue.content: ゲーム
dialogue.English: Games.

dialogue.content: ずっとゲームしてる
dialogue.English: I'm always playing games.

dialogue.content: ゲームですね！また万引きのことを思い出してしまったらゲームをしてみるのも一つかなと思います。
dialogue.English: Games, I see! If thoughts about shoplifting come up again, playing games could be one option.

dialogue.content: ゲームはいつもしてるけど
dialogue.English: I play games all the time, though.

dialogue.content: ゲームをしている間はどんな感じですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel while you're playing games?

dialogue.content: 何も考えてないかも
dialogue.English: I might not be thinking about anything.

dialogue.content: 勝つことだけ
dialogue.English: Just about winning.

dialogue.content: 強くなることだけ考えてる
dialogue.English: I'm just thinking about getting stronger.

dialogue.content: では一回ほかのことは考えなくなるのですね。
dialogue.English: So you stop thinking about other things for a while.

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: ご飯とか風呂とか忘れるからいつも怒られてる
dialogue.English: I always get yelled at because I forget to eat or take a bath.

dialogue.content: もしまた万引きをしたくなったらゲームでもいいので他に意識を向けてみてください。万引きだとあなが捕まる可能性があるので、、、
dialogue.English: If you feel the urge to shoplift again, please try to direct your attention to something else, even if it's just a game. With shoplifting, there's a chance you could get caught...

dialogue.content: それでどんな感じだったかまた来週お話にきてくれますか？
dialogue.English: And could you come back next week to talk about how that went?

dialogue.content: あ
dialogue.English: Oh...

dialogue.content: わかりました
dialogue.English: ...okay.

dialogue.content: こちらでお待ちしてますのでまたお越しくださいね。少しづつ変わっていくと思いますのでぜひお手伝いさせてください。
dialogue.English: I'll be waiting for you, so please come again. I believe things can change little by little, so please let me help you with that.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 助けてください
dialogue.English: Please help me.

dialogue.content: ええ一緒に頑張っていきましょう。本日はこちらで以上とさせていただいてよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Of course. Let's work on this together. Is it okay to end today's session here?

dialogue.content: あはい
dialogue.English: Oh, yes.

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for today. Goodbye.

dialogue.content: さようなら
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （相談者役ありがとうございました。お時間過ぎてすみません。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for taking the role of client. I'm sorry we went over time.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした。ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Good work. Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: （お疲れさまでした。失礼いたします。）
dialogue.English: (Good work. Goodbye.)
